messages:
Ana: Heads up — noticed ~2% of Feb invoices have token mismatches (metering > billing). Quick check shows router token counts higher than billing totals :eyes:
Ben: I saw spikes in router_event_count around 02:14 UTC yesterday. Might be duplicate events when we fall back across routes. Short logs: `router: emitted 1200 events in 60s, unique_request_ids 1186`
Maya: Looking at raw-events S3 — there are repeated event_id values for ~300k keys across that hour. Could be a retry loop in the route-switcher.
Devon: If event_id is duplicated we should dedupe on event_id + route. Current billing dedupe window is 60s and uses request_id if event_id missing, which is brittle.
BillingBot: FYI billing pipeline: dedupe_window=60s, primary_key=event_id, fallback=request_id. If both missing we compute tokens from model+prompt_len.
Ana: Probable cause: router retry path emits the same event_id but with different token_estimate after batching. That would let router count both versions.
Ben: Quick repro idea: force a route fail in staging, run low-latency batch and see if router emits duplicate event_id with different token counts.
Maya: I ran a staging script. Snippet:
```sql
-- staging check
select event_id, count(*) as cnt, min(token_count) as min_tok, max(token_count) as max_tok
from raw_meter_events
where ts between '2026-03-01' and '2026-03-02'
group by event_id
having count(*) > 1;
```
Maya: Result: ~420 rows where min_tok != max_tok. So duplicates with different token estimates exist.
Devon: Proposed immediate mitigation: set billing dedupe_window=5s and add dedupe_key=sha256(event_id||route||model_version) so we consider route changes. That should reduce double-counts in the short term.
Ana: That changes billing behavior mid-cycle — can't silently change invoice accounting. Need a safe rollout: run in read-only mode (flag: BILLING_DEDUPE_SIMULATE=true) to compare new vs current counts for a week.
BillingBot: We can run simulators and produce a diff report per-customer. That helps decide whether to backfill or apply live.
Ben: Also need to add telemetry: emit `dedupe_decision` metric with tags {event_id_present, dedupe_key_hash, route_changed, token_diff}. Wire to per-route dashboard.
Maya: I'll open the RFC with rollout plan and attach the simulator results. I'll also add a quick one-off reconciliation job to reconcile any invoices if we eventually change dedupe logic.
Devon: For quick triage, here's a small script to compute duplicates and token deltas:
```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-raw-events/2026/03/01/ events.jsonl
jq -c '. | {event_id, request_id, route, token_count}' events.jsonl | \
  sort | uniq -c | awk '$1>1{print $0}' > dup_report.txt
```
Ana: Action items: Maya opens RFC + simulator (owner: Maya). Ben adds router flag to reduce retry emission (owner: Ben). Devon drafts billing dedupe change with simulate flag (owner: Devon). Billing: run report and validate customer diffs (owner: BillingBot / finance).
Maya: quick notes: tagging owners in RFC, will include sample dashboard panels for `router_event_count`, `billing_ingested_tokens`, `dedupe_decisions`, and `invoice_deltas`.
Ana: Thanks all. If we see large customer diffs (>0.5%) we pause and do manual reconcile. :thumbsup:
Ben: I'll run the staging forced-fail test this afternoon and post logs. :eyes:
BillingBot: Scheduled simulation job queued (job_id: sim-20260318-01).
